events.note: Implemented one global WSL slot, local GeneralPTNN single-process loading with bounded thread env, complete QE subprocess credential scrubbing, and v6.2 blueprint synchronization. Formal review also isolated manual commands in a subshell so the operator shell is not mutated. Current MA-E16 execution was not stopped or controlled.

Low-frequency 05:30 +08:00 readback found MA-E16 at 9 completed, 2 failed and Loop12 running. Host CPU was 28.7%-34.6%, available memory about 2.0 GB and paging about 3.4k-9.0k pages/sec. Loop12 still uses the pre-merge two-worker loader, so this is evidence for the fix rather than post-fix activation. No process control was performed.

Normalized backend-main identity and business probes to executable absolute HTTP URLs and declared database readback not required because BUG-1014 has no DDL or DML. This metadata-only correction enables fail-closed post-restart verification without changing runtime behavior.

Formal review reproduced that the original compgen scrub ran under RD-Agent /bin/sh and failed open. The corrected delivery uses a fail-closed Bash contract, repeated final-boundary scrub after conda and factor env sourcing, shell-quoted paths, and an RD-Agent companion change that removes credentials and startup/loader injection before exec and atomically creates qe_resource_session_secret.json with mode 0600. MA-E16 is terminal 10 completed/2 failed; no process control or experiment retry occurred.

Third-round review found the production backtest_config.command branch inherited the backend environment because run_command received env=None. The fix now supplies scrubbed_qe_subprocess_env and adds a real poisoned-child regression test. The shared Bash scrub also skips Bash readonly option variables, normalizes exported names case-insensitively, and fails closed with a stable reason if compgen is unavailable. Scope was expanded only for the exact regression test; no process control, DDL/DML, dependency install, or experiment execution occurred.

Final review expanded PostgreSQL isolation to the full PG* libpq namespace, rejects credential or process-injection remote_env keys before values can be serialized, and canonicalizes case variants of wsl2-5080 before reservation while rejecting ambiguous local/wsl aliases so they cannot create independent slots. RD-Agent companion PR #18 was independently reviewed and merge-committed as da3270f8; its deployment/restart/identity remains pending and separate from backend-main. No runtime process control or experiment execution occurred.
